title: Museum of Holocaust Art, Yad Vashem
visualBrief: Museum of Holocaust Art, Yad Vashem: distinct mapped long narrow concrete gallery, nearly blank courtyard elevation, deep rectangular entry and metal-lined vestibule with a recessed side door, pale roof slab/parapet and a plain blue wayfinding banner. The entry remains a real recess at all four LODs. Keep the independently mapped Exhibition Pavilion, Square of Hope courtyard, gardens, other campus buildings and underground museum rooms outside this asset.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Shared campus Q156591 with independent way74078306/native35184446167138. The named map POI lies beside the southwest long face; the museum's own labelled entry and Square of Hope photos identify that face and the deeply recessed portal. The ordinary campus aerial confirms the narrow gallery along the courtyard. Internal +X follows the mapped long axis south-southeast; +Z faces west-southwest into the courtyard. Heading0 bakes these signed axes into world east/south. Portal location at internalX -5.1m is an approximation guided by the named map point, not a surveyed entrance. No independent member Wikidata ID is asserted.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: No map height exists. Picture-led working courtyard wall/roof height6.8m, portal4.2m tall and3.8m wide/depth2.32m, recessed side doors2.6m tall, parapet0.35m. Hidden rear/roof and underground galleries are not verified. The roof uses a light shared gravel substitute; planted upper terraces, irrigation, roof gardens and actual roof services are not reconstructed. Banner is a plain colour cue without copied art, text or inscriptions.
